title: Quoting Tarn Adams
summary: They took the letters from me! I have to talk about dwarf behavior now. I can't even talk about dwarf AI. It doesn't exist. It's dwarf behavior , and they misbehave sometimes — Tarn Adams , co-creator of Dwarf Fortress Tags: ai , game-design
body:
# Simon Willison’s Weblog

They took the letters from me! I have to talk about dwarf behavior now. I can't even talk about dwarf AI. It doesn't exist. It's dwarf behavior , and they misbehave sometimes

— Tarn Adams , co-creator of Dwarf Fortress

Posted 1st September 2026 at 5:01 pm

- Understanding ChatGPT Work - 30th August 2026

- Conceptual integrity and counting lines of code - 19th August 2026

- Qwen 3.8 27B is excellent, but it defaults to wildly overthinking things - 16th August 2026

This is a quotation collected by Simon Willison, posted on 1st September 2026 .
summaryZh: 西蒙·威利森博客引用了《矮人要塞》联合创造者Tarn Adams的言论，指出游戏中并不存在所谓的“矮人AI”，而只是复杂的“矮人行为”。
